risks.risk: Chair may be bent/misaligned (frame or base) even if not obvious in the photo; could affect comfort and stability.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video from side and front showing the chair standing level on the floor, plus a close-up of the base/under-seat frame for any bends.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used office chair with possible frame issue (worst case: not fully straight/needs repair).

risks.risk: Hidden stains/tears or worn upholstery not visible from this angle.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the seat top, seat underside edges, backrest corners, and armrest pads in bright light.
risks.if_unproven: Price as having unknown upholstery condition (worst case: minor stains/wear).

risks.risk: Foam may be sagging or the chair may not support weight well.
risks.proof: Ask for a video of someone sitting and standing up (showing bounce/sag) and a close-up of the seat thickness.
risks.if_unproven: Price as foam not guaranteed firm (worst case: some sag).

risks.risk: Mechanical faults: height adjustment, tilt/lock, or caster issues.
risks.proof: Ask for a video demonstrating: height lift, tilt recline, and locking/unlocking; plus a clip showing casters rolling smoothly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested (worst case: may need servicing).

risks.risk: Missing/weak parts (e.g., armrest wobble, loose screws) not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: Ask for close-ups of armrest mounting points and under-seat area, and a short shake test video.
risks.if_unproven: Price as requiring inspection/possible minor repairs.

proof_requests: Video showing the chair level on the floor (front + side) to confirm whether it is actually bent.
Close-up photos of upholstery: seat top, seat edges, backrest corners, and armrest pads.
Video demonstrating height adjustment and tilt/lock working properly.
Video showing casters rolling smoothly and no wobble when weight is applied.
Close-up of any labels/underside tag for brand/model (if present).
response.reason: From the photo, the chair type is identifiable, but key factors that determine value in Lagos (whether it’s truly bent, upholstery condition details, and whether the mechanisms work) cannot be confirmed remotely. Request the short videos/clips above before pricing.
